originalIntent: Run one isolated staged physics_capture_v1 player through request 70, accept only a fully validated synchronized shot, reject injected temporal, sidecar, and request failures without promotion, and preserve protected production assets.
desiredOutcome: A machine-readable accepted live shot and report on the happy path; nonzero rejected reports and no accepted shot for every required injection; reproducible cleanup and unchanged protected roots.
userOutcomeReview: The staged player produced a real one-frame physics_capture_v1 shot on fixed physics port 2004. The accepted artifact independently validates, contains one PNG and one exact state record, has closed state/event sidecars, nonempty entities, valid kinetic-energy calculations, deterministic support ordering, and checksum-bound provenance. All three failure injections exited nonzero, reported rejected with accepted_shot null, and produced no shot_001 promotion. Protected roots were byte/stat unchanged in every report.
